description: Land Acquisition - Yodagama, Rambukkana D/S Division, Kegalle District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily focused on land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed declarations for acquiring specific land parcels for public purposes, including descriptions of land boundaries, extents, and locations. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando), the core content is about land acquisition procedures and property descriptions, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel or structural gazette.
